// diagnostic E0782

Jet.NonSwappableEffectContext

`{effect_name}` is not a swappable effect and cannot be installed in `#Context`

What

`{effect_name}` is not a swappable effect and cannot be installed in `#Context`

Why

Structural and non-swappable effects (`Unsafe`, `Panic`, `Mem.*`, `FFI.*`, `Meta.*`, or any `#Effect(swappable: false)` trait) represent language or machine guarantees that cannot be replaced or discharged by a local handler

Fix

Remove `{effect_name}: ...` from `#Context(...)` and declare or control `{effect_name}` in the function's effect row

Worked example
